description: This file defines an enumeration GatewayDiscoveryPreferences that encapsulates preferences related to gateway discovery, specifically handling user defaults for storing and retrieving a preferred stable ID.

methods.name: preferredStableID()
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred stable ID from user defaults, considering both current and legacy keys, and trims whitespace if present.

methods.name: setPreferredStableID(_:)
methods.description: Sets or clears the preferred stable ID in user defaults, managing legacy key removal appropriately.
